summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: maskservice:PLF-22282 meaningful isolated installed-wheel test contracts and public Goal2.2.11 release after trusted source merge.

delivery.outcome: Public Goal2.2.11 contains the already accepted honest test selection and cold UV module launcher, qualified from a real installed wheel; all release metadata and non-root dependency records remain consistent.
nonGoals: No application behavior changes or new dependencies
No protected check weakening or unreviewed verifier pin changes
No registry upload before trusted exact-head source merge and no overwriting published artifacts

architecture.decision: Exercise accepted test-stage statuses/metrics and UV module/plugin startup through the actual isolated wheel installation. Update only the root version in four release projections. Coordinate exact OneDev raw-input pins through a separately governed onedev-agent producer and its safe deployment; preserve all required matrix and independent-review controls. Genuine Goal publication follows trusted source merge and immutable artifact verification.
architecture.rollback: Use a subsequent immutable public patch or protected source revert; retain previous local prefix and never overwrite existing registry artifacts.
